Seating

Mana

Mana is a seat in 20 mm birch plywood, made of four flat panels that slot together without screws or tools. Its legs offer two seat heights: 170 mm, close to the floor, for sitting cross-legged or in meditation; and 340 mm, a first step for a body used to chairs. The backrest is curved through kerf bending, turning a flat panel into a gentle support. Mana comes from a master's thesis on comfort as a means rather than an end: a meeting point between the comfort we receive and the comfort we reach.

Material
20 mm birch plywood
Seat heights
170 mm / 340 mm
Dimensions
